insights.headline: Gold's worst October since 2008; silver under $50 as technical analysts eye lower support
insights.summary: Spot gold closed Friday near $3,876 an ounce — its weakest in over a year — capping its worst October since 2008, while silver slipped below $50 to about $49.12. On MCX, gold futures settled at ₹1,38,419 per 10 grams and silver at ₹1,78,900 per kg after Friday's selloff. FXEmpire's technical analysis warns a break below $45 could push silver toward $35–$37, and FXStreet flags $3,720–$3,890 as gold's next support battleground. With Dhanteras on November 6, festive buying could offer the market some support.
points: Spot gold fell ~4% on Friday to ~$3,876, its lowest in over a year; October's ~6–7% drop was the worst since 2008.
Spot silver closed near $49.12, below $50 for the first time in ~11 months; MCX silver settled at ₹1,78,900 per kg.
MCX December gold futures fell ₹4,347 to ₹1,38,419 per 10 grams, the weakest since late March.
FXEmpire says silver risks a drop toward $45, with a break below it opening $35–$37; AI-driven industrial demand may cushion longer term.
FXStreet sees gold's next support zone at $3,720–$3,890; the December Fed meeting keeps rate-hike odds in play.

trending.title: Silver's floor test: below $50, analysts eye $45
trending.summary: Silver has lost ~57% from January's record; FXEmpire's technical analysis sees a drop toward $45 if the $48–$50 zone fails, with $35–$37 below that. The gold-silver ratio has climbed to 79.

trending.title: Technicals turn heavy for gold too
trending.summary: FXStreet says gold's plunge below $4,000 has it confronting a long-term rising trendline near $3,890; a weekly close below could open $3,761–$3,785, with $3,720 the next arc-level focus.

trending.title: Worst October since 2008
trending.summary: Gold's ~6–7% October slide was its worst since the 2008 crisis; the tech selloff and hot US inflation have traders pricing a December Fed rate hike.

trending.title: Dhanteras on Nov 6: festive demand may cushion the fall
trending.summary: Gold futures are down ~23% from January's record, making Dhanteras buying cheaper; jewellers are rolling out festive offers ahead of the Nov 6 buying.

items.title: Crash! Gold price suffers worst October in years: Did silver and platinum suffer too? Check monthly performance
items.summary: Mint's monthly review: gold logged its worst October in years, sinking to a one-year low near $3,876 an ounce, while silver and platinum suffered too — silver slipped below $50 for the first time in nearly a year and platinum hit a 13-month low. The piece traces the selloff to hot US inflation data, Fed rate-hike bets and a broader market rout.

items.title: Gold plunges ₹3,200 to 10-month low of ₹1.42 lakh; silver slides ₹4,200
items.summary: Gold in Delhi fell ₹3,200 to ₹1.42 lakh per 10 grams on Saturday, a 10-month low, while silver slid ₹4,200 per kg, according to the All India Sarafa Association. The slide extends the week's global selloff driven by US rate-hike expectations, rising oil prices and inflation fears, landing just days before Dhanteras and Diwali.

items.title: Silver Price Forecast: Tech Sell-Off Raises Risk of a Drop to $45
items.summary: FXEmpire's technical analysis says silver is testing $48–$50 support after a tech-led selloff dragged it below key levels. A confirmed break under $45 could open a move toward $35–$37, while a close back above $60 would strengthen a bottom; heavy AI spending may attract buyers at lower prices.

items.title: Gold, silver may extend losses as US vote, jobs data test sentiment
items.summary: Analysts told Business Standard that gold and silver may extend losses this week as investors track the US midterm vote on November 3, US jobs data, and geopolitical tensions for cues on bullion prices. MCX December gold fell Rs 3,539 (2.5%) in the week to Rs 1.38 lakh per 10 grams, while silver dropped Rs 16,587 (8.5%) to Rs 1.79 lakh per kg, JM Financial and LKP Securities analysts said.

items.title: Tech rout drives gold to one-year low, white metals sink deep into oversold zone
items.summary: Spot gold fell 3.5% to $3,880.97/oz — lowest since October 2025 — as Friday's tech slump on AI spending doubts forced safe-haven selling and margin calls, reports the Economic Times (Reuters). Silver fell 6.5% to $49, an 11-month low; platinum and palladium slid to $1,425 and $976. Analysts see recovery with central-bank buying below $4,000, though weak industrial demand keeps silver soft.

items.title: When support gives way: Gold and Silver's Friday showdown
items.summary: FXStreet's technical note says gold has plunged below $4,000 toward a long-term support zone near $3,890, with a weekly close below it opening $3,761–$3,785; silver broke $50 (futures) to $4,931, while platinum and palladium also sit at bearish supports.

Spot gold sank about 3.5% to near $3,880 an ounce and silver slid 6% to about $49 in late US trading Friday, as a tech-led equity selloff forced investors to raise cash. Falling Treasury yields and fresh geopolitical risk from another tanker attack in the Strait of Hormuz failed to cushion the fall, with higher oil prices stoking fears the Fed will stay restrictive.
items.title: Gold falls below $3,900, silver tumbles as Wall Street selloff triggers liquidation - Kitco PM Report
Silver loses more than half its value from record high: What went wrong and will it recover?
items.summary: Silver has fallen more than 58% from its record high of nearly $120 an ounce in the London spot market earlier this year to around $50, The Economic Times reports. Geojit's Hareesh V attributes the unraveling to profit-booking, slower industrial demand growth and shifting macro conditions, after the record rally was driven by tight supply, solar and electronics demand, and investment inflows.

items.title: Silver Is Falling Despite Lower Treasury Yields and a Persistent Supply Deficit
items.summary: Przemyslaw Radomski, CFA, argues silver's slide is a rates-and-sentiment story rather than a supply story: falling Treasury yields have not rescued prices, while the Silver Institute projects a sixth straight annual supply deficit of about 46 million ounces in 2026. He sees macro headwinds - a firm dollar and December Fed hike bets - outweighing the tight physical balance.

items.title: Silver Price Crash: 1 Kg Silver May Soon Equal 10 Grams of Gold as Gold-Silver Ratio Hits 79
items.summary: The gold-silver ratio has climbed to 79 from below 50 in January as silver's crash outpaced gold's. MCX silver is down about 57% from its Rs 4,20,048/kg peak to Rs 1,78,900; gold is down about 23% to Rs 1,38,419/10g. At these levels silver needs to fall another 22.6% — gold flat — for 1 kg to equal 10 grams of gold. Metals Focus sees silver supply easing into a 2027 surplus.

items.title: How did gold and silver perform in India ahead of Dhanteras and Diwali?
items.summary: IBJA data shows gold closed the week over Rs 2,200 per 10 grams cheaper after a swing of more than Rs 2,600, while silver closed over Rs 9,100 per kg lower with a Rs 13,135 per kg weekly swing — capping a volatile week for Indian buyers just days before Dhanteras and Diwali.

items.title: Gold, silver lose sheen
items.summary: Gold and silver closed October with a second straight monthly loss, per The Hindu BusinessLine's technical review: Comex gold fell 7.26% to $3,884.9/oz and silver 19.1% to $49.13; MCX gold slid 7.16% to Rs 1,38,419/10g and silver 20% to Rs 1,78,900/kg. Drivers: higher crude, sticky inflation, December Fed hike bets. Column flags Comex gold risk at $3,650-$3,750 and silver at $42-$43.

NDTV Profit calculates that Rs 1 lakh buys about 7.1 grams of 24-carat gold this Dhanteras — roughly 25% more than the ~5.7 grams it fetched at January's Rs 1,75,340 peak — with IBJA gold at Rs 1,40,054 per 10 grams on October 30. Gold is still ~8% costlier than last Dhanteras, and analysts favor staggered buying into the November 6 festival.
items.title: Your Rs 1 Lakh Buys 25% More Gold This Dhanteras Than In January. Should You Invest?
Dhanteras 2026: How To Check Gold Purity, Hallmarking And Making Charges
items.summary: Ahead of Dhanteras on November 6, Outlook Money walks buyers through checking gold purity via karat and fineness marks, verifying the three BIS hallmark signs including the six-digit HUID code, and scrutinising the bill for making charges, net weight and GST before paying.

items.title: Khimji Jewellers Unveils 'Dhanteras Dhanvarsha', a shower of festive offers across its collections
items.summary: Odisha jeweller Khimji has launched its 'Dhanteras Dhanvarsha' festive campaign across its showrooms from October 30: flat 40% off gold jewellery making charges, 20% off diamonds, 25% off silver and platinum making charges, plus 999-purity gold and silver coins in 5g-100g backed by a buyback guarantee and full-value exchange on old gold from any jeweller.

The RBI has fixed the redemption price of Sovereign Gold Bond 2021-22 Series VII at ₹14,167 per unit, with the exit window opening November 2, 2026, five years after issue. Investors who bought at ₹4,765 per gram in October 2021 lock in roughly 197% capital appreciation — about ₹3 lakh on a ₹1 lakh investment — plus 2.5% annual interest. The price averages IBJA 999-gold closes of Oct 28-30.
